description: This file defines factory functions for creating MaskedTensor objects, including 'masked_tensor' and 'as_masked_tensor'. It sets up the public API for creating masked tensor instances, mirroring PyTorch tensor creation functions.

classes.name: MaskedTensor
classes.description: A class representing a tensor with an associated mask, used for masked tensor operations.
